title: Affordable Decorating
body:
At a recent unclaimed property auction, a warehouse and office complex was purchased. By whom is not documented on this site, nor is it interesting or relevant.

The complex’s occupant from some time in the mid 1970s until the mid 1990s was Affordable Decorating, a design consultancy firm. Their stated mission was:
"Supply high-volume, low-cost decorating materials to hotels, corporate offices, and municipal buildings." 

This site catalogues the contents of this building for primarily archival purposes as required by a clause in the auction contract that the purchaser (again, not interesting, relevant nor documented) did not notice and that probably explains the surprising lack of competing bids at auction.

Select items from the warehouse are or will be made available for purchase via personal correspondence. This is discouraged, but not explicitly forbidden by the aforementioned clause in the auction contract. 

We assume no liability for any legal action against buyers if this turns out to be a bad decision on our part. As of yet, we are unsure what legal entities exist that could take action to enforce this clause, but our legal team has advised us to comply with the mandated archiving out of caution. Please see the [About](about/index.html) page for all legal notices.

The firm's Intranet has been partially recovered for assistance in understanding the purpose of many of the items that were found in the initial warehouse inventory efforts that do not seem to fit the firm’s stated mission. The currently available pages can be found in our [intranet archive](intranet:home) and will be updated as further recovery proceeds.
